record_title: An effective criterion for Zumkeller numbers of the form 2^a p q
scientific_context: For n=2^a p q with odd primes p<q, the Zumkeller condition is automatic when p<=2^(a+1)-1; beyond that threshold it is equivalent to abundance plus a bounded three-coefficient representation. The criterion makes every fixed a finite and yields complete classifications for a<=4.
limitations: The theorem treats the squarefree odd part pq and does not classify 2^a p^b q^c with larger odd exponents or numbers with four or more distinct prime factors. For arbitrary a the criterion is effective but not reduced here to a closed-form exception list. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from equivalent specializations under different terminology. The exact finite verification supports the low-exponent classifications but is not a substitute for the general proof.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer exhaustive verification of the fixed-exponent classifications and direct divisor-subset cross-checks.
Deterministic output of the exhaustive finite verification for a=1,2,3,4 and supplementary automatic-region checks.
